name: JupUSD
oneLiner: JupUSD is Jupiter's dollar stablecoin on Solana, backed 90% by Ethena USDtb (BlackRock BUIDL T-bills) and 10% USDC, with 1:1 mint and redeem against USDC.
collateral: 90% USDtb (BlackRock BUIDL tokenized U.S. Treasuries issued by Ethena under GENIUS-compliant framework, custodied by Porto/Anchorage Digital) and 10% USDC liquidity buffer
pegMechanism: Reserve-backed 1:1 mint and redeem on Solana against USDC; Ethena manages day-to-day reserve operations (custody, bridging, rebalancing between USDtb and USDC)

applicabilityBasis.summary: JupUSD is a USD-pegged reserve-backed token issued on Solana for payment/settlement use within Jupiter's DeFi ecosystem; it presents as a payment stablecoin under GENIUS Act definitions. Jupiter's Terms of Service restrict US-based users, but this is an access restriction, not a legal carve-out from GENIUS applicability.

genius.issuerEntity: Jupiter (Solana DEX aggregator, no disclosed US legal entity; Ethena Labs operates issuance backend)
genius.notes: JupUSD's primary reserve asset (USDtb) is now issued in the US by Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. under a GENIUS-compliant framework (announced July 24, 2025; Anchorage is the USDtb issuer, not JupUSD's issuer). JupUSD itself has no GENIUS authorization — it is a separate token issued by Jupiter on Solana with no disclosed US legal entity or regulatory registration. Jupiter restricts US users in its ToS but no formal foreign-exception determination has been made. No public GENIUS approval, application, or issuer pathway source for JupUSD itself was located.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No GENIUS approval, application, or issuer pathway for JupUSD or its issuer (Jupiter) found across federal/state regulator sources and issuer disclosures. USDtb's Anchorage/GENIUS pathway applies to the reserve asset issuer (Anchorage Digital Bank N.A.), not JupUSD itself.

reserveReview.rationale: The exact July 14 JupUSD reserve capture reports 88.5% USDtb and 11.5% USDC. Jupiter documents both as accepted reserve collateral and says target weights can fluctuate around 90/10 as reserves are rebalanced.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Both direct reserve assets are identified and linked to tracked upstream stablecoins; their underlying reserve composition is reviewed on those assets.

mintAuthority.summary: JupUSD mint and freeze authority is a PDA of the JupUSD program. The program is upgradeable through a zero-delay autonomous Squads v4 multisig with threshold 4 of 9, so that multisig can change the permissioned mint logic without replacing the SPL mint.

controls.label: JupUSD mint and freeze authority (PDA of JupUSD program)
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432737041, the mint and freeze authorities were both CkzLnD9r4d4ZZofsgNVo2VNunxDmte5YJ4vfAgMfBZNA. A successful mint at slot 432727339 shows JUPUSDecMzAVgztLe6eGhwUBj1Pn3j9WAXwmtHmfbRr invoking SPL Token mintTo with that PDA as authority.

controls.label: JupUSD program upgrade authority (Squads 4-of-9 vault)
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432737041, JUPUSDecMzAVgztLe6eGhwUBj1Pn3j9WAXwmtHmfbRr pointed to ProgramData GF7fyG3MC28FzpNVH1rm9AAoDBR9kHTSvGcCoV9a8wkz, whose live upgrade authority was this Squads vault. The vault is index 0 for autonomous multisig H4siPbdsgRDoNHyWb1UsTzNhDRAVNoV5MNKjxtL4chzX, configured 4-of-9 with time_lock 0. Upgrade transaction 2M36bgx... executed through Squads and invoked the BPF Upgradeable Loader.

controls.label: Ethena Labs issuance backend / reserve operator
controls.evidence: JupUSD is issued on Ethena Labs' Stablecoin-as-a-Service infrastructure; Ethena manages reserve operations, custody coordination (Porto/Anchorage), and rebalancing between USDtb and USDC, operating the mint/redeem framework on Jupiter's behalf. On-chain permissioning is enforced by the upgradeable JupUSD program.

review.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432737041, the JupUSD mint and freeze authority was the program PDA CkzLnD9r.... The program's full ProgramData account GF7fyG3M... named live upgrade authority 31wgH9C..., a zero-delay autonomous 4/9 Squads v4 vault. The classic SPL Token program and Squads v4 program are themselves immutable, leaving the JupUSD program as the only mutable executable in the observed direct mint path. Reconciliation review (2026-08-08): JupUSD reserves are held in named Solana token accounts that any third party can read directly, so the collateralisation ratio is recomputable from chain state rather than taken on the issuer's word. Independent verification against mainnet RPC found six accounts holding USDtb and USDC across Anchorage Digital, Coinbase Custody and an on-chain program buffer totalling about $52.88m against a mint supply of 52,858,698.33 JUPUSD, roughly 100.05% coverage, refreshed on a 10-60s poll. No attestor, attestation section or regulatory disclosure exists on the transparency surface; the monthly attestations in press coverage belong to USDtb, the collateral issuer, not to JupUSD, so supervision is none.
